method: All fields independently compared with FILES.HDR using clean unattended-debugger raw-1-entry.p2s; no guest mutations or game patches.

segments.matched_fields: runtime +12 first and +16 count equal every HDR pair first/count

records.matched_fields: all NUL-terminated names/type/length equal HDR; every chunk adds 125000 FILES.DAT base LBA; bytes after name NUL are not preserved
